content_sections.heading: PDKV Contractual Assistant Librarian at a Glance

rows.details: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth, Akola
Fixed emoluments of Rs. 25,000/- per month
Bachelor of Library Science (B. Lib.) or Master of Library Science (M. Lib.)

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must submit their application in hard copy on A4 size paper only in the given format along with self-attested photocopies of their documents. The application must be addressed to The Associate Dean, Bhausaheb Fundkar Government College of Agriculture, C/o Agril. Technical School, Dhad Road, Buldhana (Sagwan), Dist. Buldhana-443002. Applications must reach on or before 22nd October, 2026 up to 17.00 hrs by post, speed post, or courier. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered. The prescribed application format is available on the university website under the recruitment tab.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential Qualification: Candidate must have passed Bachelor of Library Science (B. Lib.) or Master of Library Science (M. Lib.) from a recognized Institute. Job Description: The selected candidate will have to perform work related to the college library and carry out duties and work assigned by the college authority for the period of 11 months.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Documents pertaining to date of birth Educational qualification certificates (Bachelor or Master of Library Science) Experience certificate, if any NET/SET exam certificate, if passed Caste Certificate and Caste Validity (if applicable) Aadhar card copy Any other relevant documents concerning the claim Self-attested copies of all submitted documents

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: After scrutiny of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be called for a personal interview in a 1:5 ratio. The interview will be conducted in offline mode at Bhausaheb Fundkar Government College of Agriculture, Buldhana Dist. Buldhana-443002. The date, place, and time of the interview will be communicated to eligible candidates through E-mail and published on the university website. Candidates must show all original required and claimed documents at the time of the personal interview and before joining.

rows.event: Last Date for Receipt of Applications

faq.question: Q1. Is this post permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a purely temporary contract basis for a period of 11 months from the date of issue of the consent letter, and the incumbent has no claim for regular appointment under Dr. PDKV, Akola.

faq.question: Q2. How will candidates be shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: After scrutiny of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be called for a personal interview in a 1:5 ratio. The schedule will be communicated through E-mail and published on the university website.

faq.question: Q3. Which documents need to be attached and brought along?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit and bring self-attested copies of documents for date of birth, educational qualification (B. Lib. or M. Lib.), experience certificate (if any), NET/SET score (if passed), Caste Certificate, Caste Validity, Aadhar card copy, and any other relevant claim documents, along with original copies at the interview.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit hard copy applications by post, speed post, or courier is 22nd October, 2026 up to 17.00 hrs.
